title: Abbott Launches Denosumab Biosimilars in Pakistan
excerpt: Abbott has secured approval from DRAP to introduce denosumab biosimilars in Pakistan for osteoporosis and cancer-related bone conditions.
body_html:
Global healthcare company Abbott has secured product registration from the Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan for 60 mg denosumab biosimilars.

The newly approved treatments are intended for patients suffering from osteoporosis as well as various cancer-related bone conditions.

This regulatory approval allows the introduction of these biosimilar medications to the local market, expanding treatment options for individuals managing bone density loss and oncology-related bone complications within the country.
